description: This file defines a generic logging adapter class 'LoggerAdapter<T>' that implements the 'IAppLogger<T>' interface. It wraps an 'ILogger<T>' instance provided via dependency injection, providing methods to log warning and information messages.

classes.name: LoggerAdapter<T>
classes.description: A generic class implementing 'IAppLogger<T>' that delegates logging calls to an internal 'ILogger<T>' instance.

methods.name: LoggerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that creates an internal logger instance using the provided ILoggerFactory.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional arguments.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional arguments.
